item.title: Show HN: Share context between friends via MCP
item.summary: A crosswalk connects a group of people through their Claude Codes, like a website connects people through their browser. It's a shared context for all members to read and share to. You and a buddy on a side hustle, classmates on a project, build for the builders' commons, or gtm for go-to-market engineering.
